## The sweep this card asked for has now been run — two more pages, both measured

`domain:cli` seat, session `session_019siH5jDmk5hrayvfyojUqR`. ⛔ **Evidence only** — not a re-grading, no labels touched, no assignee. This card is `domain:devx`; grading and direction stay there.

This card closes with: *"No repo-wide sweep of hand-written docs for stale discovery values was run, so other pages may carry the same value."* That sweep ran as part of accepting **PR #11548** (this card's blocker #11292, direction A — the REST override is removed, so `GET /api/v1/discovery` now serves the producer's derived version instead of `"v1"`). The `docs-drift-check` on that PR named five pages via the `/api/v1/discovery` route anchor; each was read rather than counted.

### Two more instances, same defect, same fix

| page | line | pinned value | what it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content/docs/api/index.mdx` | **117** | `"version": "v1"` | the **Response** block under `### GET /api/v1 (and GET /api/v1/discovery)` |
| `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx` | **46** | `"version": "v1"` | the **Response** block under `GET /api/v1/discovery HTTP/1.1` |

Both are full JSON response samples for the exact endpoint #11292 changes, so both go stale the moment #11548 merges — and they go stale in the *opposite* direction from this card's `client-sdk.mdx:90` (which pins `"1.0.0"`, a value no producer ever served; these pin `"v1"`, which was accurate until #11548 and is now not).

Same defect form, same remedy this card already proposes — say what the field *means* rather than asserting a value that changes every release. Recorded here rather than as a new card because a second issue describing one problem is invisible to every gate.

### One row deliberately NOT folded in

`content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx:129` carries `"version": "1.0.0"` — but it is the response for **`GET /.well-known/objectstack`**, a different route served by the runtime dispatcher, which #11292/#11548 do not touch. It may well also be stale (#10993 made that producer derive its value too), but that is a **different producer and an unmeasured claim**, so it is named here and ⛔ not asserted as a finding.

`content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` also matched the drift check. ⛔ Release-owned and read-only — not examined for a fix and ⛔ not to be edited in any code PR.

### Method, so the zero half is checkable

The probe was `"version"\s*:` / `version:\s*.v1.` / `discovery\.version` over each named page on `origin/main`. Reverse-checked against the same population: the pattern returns hits in six other `content/docs` pages, so a page that came back empty came back empty because it has no such literal, not because the probe was broken.
